contract.title: 32-bit shift register
contract.description: Build a 32-bit serial-in parallel-out shift register. DIN is the data lever, CLK the clock lever. On every rising edge of CLK the register shifts by one place and takes in the value DIN had just before the edge: Q0 := DIN, Q1 := old Q0, ..., Q31 := old Q30. The lamps Q0..Q31 show the register (Q0 is the first place, nearest to DIN). Switching CLK off changes nothing. All lamps are off at the start. DIN is changed at least 10 ticks before an edge. Library hint (component tier only): a D flip-flop (captures D on the rising edge of CLK) is available.
